reddit.title: Improved Audio Experience in Provincia: Soft Music Reloops
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the audio experience in Provincia! The day, night, title, and combat music beds now transition smoothly without hard cuts, thanks to a long equal-power self-crossfade that hides AI joins. This means you can enjoy a seamless audio experience while building your colony. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
